message.reasoning_content: Record description update. Key risk: all candidates at radius ~1 from query, quantization grid 0.125 means all candidates likely quantize identically or near-identically → wrong winner. Kernel quantizes both query and candidates; contract uses exact float64 distances. Distances ~1 vs quantization error up to ~0.044 per coord per candidate — winner may differ from reference index.
